The outlined treatment plan for Alice's Type 2 diabetes is highly appropriate and aligns with standard clinical guidelines. The combination of lifestyle modifications—specifically a low glycemic index diet and regular moderate-intensity exercise—addresses the root causes of insulin resistance and helps manage weight. Daily blood sugar monitoring allows for effective tracking of glycemic control, while metformin is the first-line pharmacological intervention for Type 2 diabetes. Furthermore, scheduling follow-up appointments every three months is standard practice to assess HbA1c levels, adjust medications if necessary, and ensure the treatment plan remains effective.

The bird known for its ability to repeat what you say is the parrot.
